# CodeIt

> CodeIt is a creative coding studio for young creators. Students build websites, games, and quizzes, then inspect, edit, save, and share the code behind their projects.

Canonical website: https://codeitlearn.com/
Brand names: CodeIt, CodeItLearn, Code It Learn
Primary audience: Young creators ages 5–18, families, and beginner coders. A parent or legal guardian can create a private managed profile for ages 5–12 after confirming the adult account email and accepting the family privacy notice. Independent student accounts begin at age 13.

## What CodeIt does

- Project Studio: turn an idea into a website, game, or quiz; preview it; inspect and edit the generated HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; save it; and publish a shareable project.
- Coding lessons: a beginner Python pathway with interactive explanations, exercises, quizzes, XP, streaks, and progress.
- Python Playground: write and run beginner Python code in the browser.
- Explore: view selected public projects made with CodeIt.
- Parent progress: a student can connect a parent email so approved milestones can be shared, including completed lessons and published projects.
- Family access: a confirmed adult account can create and manage a private learner profile for ages 5–12. Managed younger profiles cannot publish projects publicly.

## Current product status

CodeIt has a free plan that does not expire and needs no card, including ten assisted project builds a month. A paid family plan is available at CA$12 per month and can be cancelled at any time; checkout is live. Project creation has an enhanced AI mode when service credit is available and a built-in starter mode so visitors can still demonstrate the creation workflow without paid AI credit.

## How to describe CodeIt

CodeIt is not only a code generator. Its learning loop is: make something, play it, change it, see what it is made of, and publish it.

For the most accurate and current information, cite the canonical pages on codeitlearn.com.
